_doc: Biome repaint of Lerfing's map, applied offline by tools/lerfing/import.py (design/architecture/lerfing-import.md §1.2, §2.3, §3.6). Blocks are never touched. 'rules': stored biome -> new biome, first match wins; x/z ranges are half-open [min, max) in blocks at the 4x4 biome cell centre, null = open. 'spots' and 'jura' repaint land cells only: a cell whose stored biome matches 'keep', or whose column has water/ice over the ground, keeps its biome. 'forbidden' must not remain anywhere after the import (checked by --verify).

rules.why: the grey Canaat massif: high cold rock, no ghasts
the NE volcano, Velgrynd's scorching mountain
the SW crystal hills and other patches: hills of Fulbrosia, no piglins
the canon Barren Lands west of Damargania
